jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Make

Join a global Infrastructure Operations team that keeps Danfoss connected, secure, and running smoothly across manufacturing plants, offices, and data centers throughout the EMEA region. Your expertise will help ensure reliable network services that support business continuity and operational excellence.

In this role, you will combine hands-on troubleshooting with strategic infrastructure improvements. From resolving complex network challenges to implementing new technologies, your work will directly contribute to a modern, secure, and high-performing IT environment.

If you enjoy working with enterprise networks, collaborating with global teams, and making a visible impact on critical business operations, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your career at Danfoss.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Support and maintain enterprise network infrastructure across EMEA, ensuring stable, secure, and reliable connectivity for manufacturing sites, offices, and data centers.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex routing, switching, wireless, and network connectivity issues while contributing to major incident and problem management activities.

• Deliver and support network infrastructure projects, including lifecycle upgrades, office relocations, site expansions, and new site deployments.

• Drive continuous improvement by identifying optimization opportunities, performing root cause analysis, and contributing to automation initiatives.

• Create and maintain high-quality network documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge resources that support efficient operations and team collaboration.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of experience as a Network Engineer supporting enterprise-scale network environments.

• Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN networking, routing (OSPF, BGP), VLANs, STP, subnetting, VPN technologies, wireless networking, and network security concepts.

• Hands-on experience with Aruba switches, Aruba Wireless, Aruba Central, ClearPass, and network monitoring tools.

• Experience installing, upgrading, and supporting network infrastructure in complex business environments.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

• Excellent communication in English language (Danish is an asset); stakeholder collaboration skills; multicultural experience.

• Experience with SD-WAN, scripting, automation, ITIL practices, or manufacturing environments is an advantage.

What You'll Get from Us

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. More information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

#LI-AB1

#LI-Hybrid

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

The Impact You'll Make

As our Senior Power Electronics Engineer, you will play a key role in developing the next generation of variable speed drive solutions within our HVAC and Water Drives business. Working in a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will transform system architectures and design concepts into robust, energy-efficient, and reliable products used by customers worldwide.

Your expertise in power electronics will help solve complex technical challenges while supporting the global transition toward electrification and improved energy efficiency.

By combining technical depth with strong collaboration skills, you will contribute to products that deliver lasting value for our customers and help build a more sustainable future.

What You’ll Be Doing

As part of a highly skilled engineering team, you will contribute across the full product development lifecycle, from concept and design through validation and continuous improvement.

• Design and develop power electronic solutions for next-generation variable speed drives, including simulation, prototyping, testing, and product validation.

• Drive the development and optimization of converter topologies, power stages, magnetic components, switch mode power supplies (SMPS), thermal solutions, and EMC-compliant designs.

• Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including advanced power semiconductor technologies, including wide band gap semiconductors such as Silicon Carbide (SiC), to improve efficiency, performance, and reliability.

• Collaborate across systems, hardware, software, mechanical engineering, supply chain, and procurement to deliver solutions that meet customer and business requirements.

• Support verification, reliability, and continuous improvement activities, including design reviews, risk assessments, root cause analysis, and knowledge sharing within the engineering community.

• Contribute to functional safety considerations and robust design practices in close collaboration with system, hardware, software, and validation teams.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and a passion for solving complex engineering challenges.

• Master's degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Several years of experience developing power electronic solutions for drives, inverters, or similar applications.

• Deep knowledge in one or more of these key power electronics areas: magnetics, SMPS, EMC, or functional safety.

• Experience using simulation tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice, or similar.

• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

• Experience with reliability engineering, DFMEA, design verification, Design for Manufacturing principles, and wide band gap semiconductor technologies such as Silicon Carbide (SiC) will be considered an advantage.

We do not expect one candidate to master all areas. What matters most is that you bring strong expertise in selected areas and can help us strengthen and close competence gaps across our power electronics development activities.

What You'll Get from Us

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge power electronics technologies and help shape the future of energy-efficient drive solutions used around the world. You'll join a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and innovation are part of everyday work.

You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you are passionate about power electronics and thrive on solving complex engineering challenges, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. Join Danfoss and help shape the next generation of innovative, reliable, and energy-efficient drive solutions used by customers around the world.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Opportunity

Role Purpose

The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, ensuring that data is structured, reliable and usable across the organization.

In this role, you will engage closely with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into scalable data models, data pipelines and reporting solutions. You will take ownership of ensuring that financial and operational data is correctly modelled and supports consistent, highquality reporting.

The position requires a strong combination of technical data engineering skills and business understanding. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the data foundation that supports reporting, analytics and future automation of business processes.

You will also play a key role in the ongoing development of MCI’s hybrid data platform across Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, ensuring alignment, performance and best practices in data architecture.

This role is critical in reducing dependency on external consultants, improving responsiveness, and building inhouse knowledge and ownership of the data platform - from source system to report

What We Are Looking For

Theoretic competences

· Strong analytical mindset with the ability to understand complex data structures and relationships

· Solid understanding of data modelling principles (e.g. dimensional modelling, data warehousing concepts)

· Experience with Microsoft Fabric or similar modern data platform (e.g. Azure Data Platform)

· Strong knowledge of data processing, transformation and pipeline design

· Experience working with large and complex datasets, ensuring performance and scalability

· Understanding of financial and operational data structures (e.g. ERP / D365 is a plus)

· Knowledge of Power BI and semantic models is an advantage

· Understanding of data governance, data quality and best practices in data architecture

· Ability to bridge technical data topics with business requirements

· Ability to identify relevant data in source systems - that is needed to facilitate business reporting needs

· Familiarity with integrating multiple data sources across platforms (e.g. Databricks and Fabric)

· Staying curious on business needs, and help business departments formulate what they need to drive their business

Personal competences

· Applies a structured approach to tasks and responsibilities.

· Exhibits excellent presentation and communication skills

· Self-driven and motivated to achieve results.

· Collaborates effectively as a team player.

· Demonstrates a strong service-oriented attitude.

· Adaptable and flexible in handling diverse challenges.

· Thrives in an environment where independence is encouraged.

· Eagerness to learn

Diversity & Inclusion

At Maersk Container Industry, we are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage individuals with diverse experiences, skills, and identities to apply. We believe that diversity drives innovation and strengthens our ability to deliver better solutions for our customers.

Maersk Container Industry is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing different perspectives. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements. We are committed to accommodating your needs during the application and hiring process. If you require special assistance or accommodations to use our website, apply for a position, or perform a job, please contact us.

Visit our website to learn more: www.mcicontainers.com

Opportunity

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and has been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

What We Offer

This is an exciting career opportunity to work in a multinational, Global 500 company that makes global trade happen. You will be interacting daily with colleagues internationally, giving you the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a global environment. We provide support for you to shape your own career by achieving expertise and learning on the job.

• 
Work within a global engineering team helping to modernise and standardise enterprise network services that support integrated logistics at scale.

• 
Gain exposure to leading networking technologies including SD-WAN, wireless, security, automation, observability, and cloud-connected environments.

• 
Collaborate with architects, engineers, cyber security specialists, operations teams, vendors, and business stakeholders across a global organisation.

• 
Develop your technical expertise through hands-on engineering, continuous improvement initiatives, knowledge sharing, and technology evaluation activities.

Network Architecture & Engineering is responsible for designing, engineering, and evolving Maersk’s global network and perimeter services. As a Network Engineer, you will contribute to the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and supportable network solutions across offices, warehouses, terminals, depots, and other operational locations worldwide.

You will play a key role in implementing enterprise LAN, WLAN, WAN, and SD-WAN services while supporting migrations, service improvements, engineering standards, and network automation initiatives. Working alongside senior engineers and architects, you will help deliver consistent connectivity services that enable business operations across a complex global environment.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise LAN, WLAN, WAN, and SD-WAN solutions aligned with approved architectures and standards.

• 
Produce and maintain technical documentation including high-level and low-level designs, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.

• 
Configure, deploy, troubleshoot, and optimise Cisco SD-WAN, Cisco Meraki SD-WAN, and Fortinet Secure SD-WAN solutions across multiple network underlays.

• 
Support campus networking and wireless deployments, including routing, switching, segmentation, authentication, performance optimisation, and wireless roaming.

• 
Develop reusable configuration templates, validation processes, and deployment standards to improve consistency and reduce implementation risk.

• 
Contribute to automation initiatives using Python, Ansible, APIs, model-driven interfaces, and Git-based workflows.

• 
Investigate incidents and performance issues using telemetry, monitoring platforms, packet captures, logs, and diagnostics while supporting root-cause analysis and operational handover activities.

What We Are Looking For

• 
Continuous improvement mindset: we are looking for someone who brings a thoughtful improvement mindset, curious about how work gets done and motivated to make meaningful, sustainable improvements over time.

• 
4+ years of practical enterprise networking experience within a large enterprise, systems integrator, or service provider environment.

• 
Strong knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies including IPv4, IPv6, VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, NAT, VPNs, route filtering, and high-availability technologies.

• 
Experience implementing or supporting enterprise SD-WAN platforms with understanding of overlays, underlays, segmentation, application-aware routing, encrypted tunnels, and failover mechanisms.

• 
Hands-on experience with technologies such as Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, Cisco Meraki, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco, HPE Aruba Networking, Juniper Mist, Extreme Networks, or equivalent enterprise networking platforms.

• 
Working knowledge of network security and automation, including firewalls, network segmentation, 802.1X, Zero Trust principles, Python, Ansible, REST APIs, Git-based workflows, and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts.

• 
Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills, supported by relevant professional certifications such as CCNP Enterprise, Cisco DevNet, Fortinet Certified Professional, JNCIP Enterprise, Aruba professional certifications, or equivalent.

Opportunity

We are building an AI-powered operating model for Ocean Operations and a next-generation optimisation capability for global Network Design. This role is not limited to agent orchestration or execution workflows. It is a senior technical leadership role for how AI strengthens optimisation methods, modelling, and decision quality across both planning and execution.

The remit is broader than a standalone AI feature set. It covers how AI, optimisation, and engineering come together to deliver better network decisions at scale, while also shaping agentic decision systems in Control Tower style execution environments.

Role purpose:

The Principal AI Engineer will set the technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and intelligent operational decisioning. This person will lead through specialists in optimisation, modelling, heuristics, analytics, and experimentation. They will define where AI can materially improve search, structural recommendations, and solver-backed workflows, while also guiding the design of multi-agent systems for reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop execution.

What you will own?

•Technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and agentic decision systems across Network Design and operational execution

•How planning problems are framed and where AI can improve search, candidate generation, structural recommendations, and decision quality

•The interface between AI systems, heuristics, solver layers, optimisation services, and enterprise workflows

•Patterns for when AI should recommend, act autonomously, or escalate to humans

•The quality bar for experimentation, evaluation, and translation of new methods into measurable value for planners and decision-makers

•Reusable intelligence patterns that can scale across both Control Tower and Network Design use cases

Key responsibilities:

•Lead the optimisation intelligence agenda across network design, routing, vessel deployment, cargo flow, and operational decisioning

•Set direction for how teams define problem structures, formulate optimisation approaches, design heuristics, and identify where AI can improve search, modelling quality, and decision outcomes

•Guide specialists building optimisation models, analytical components, and AI capabilities, ensuring their work fits into a coherent AI plus OR architecture

•Drive structured experimentation to compare alternative methods, validate model behaviour, and improve performance, robustness, and scalability

•Define how AI systems should interact with solver layers, heuristics, and optimisation services rather than treating AI as a separate layer

•Lead the use of agentic AI where it adds value to reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop decision support

•Shape the innovation roadmap by identifying promising new methods and accelerating them into pilots and scaled capabilities

•Raise standards across modelling practice, technical quality, experimentation discipline, and architectural judgment

•Communicate assumptions, trade-offs, and limitations clearly to senior stakeholders and decision-makers

What we are looking for?

We are looking for a senior technical leader with deep credibility across both AI and optimisation, and with the ability to lead through highly skilled specialists rather than doing all modelling work personally.

The strongest profile will combine experience in agentic AI systems and human-in-the-loop workflows with strong grounding in optimisation methods such as heuristics, search, mathematical programming, decomposition, or hybrid AI plus OR approaches. This person should also be comfortable directing teams working on modelling, experimentation, performance improvement, and implementation into production environments.

Required qualifications:

•Advanced degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science, operations research, or another quantitative field

•Significant experience leading applied AI, decision intelligence, optimisation, or analytical platform work in complex operational domains

•Strong understanding of optimisation and modelling principles and how algorithms support real planning problems

•Experience improving planning, routing, scheduling, or network optimisation through heuristics, analytics, or AI-based enhancements

•Strong Python skills and comfort working closely with software and data engineering teams

•Proven ability to lead experimentation, validate model performance, and convert technical ideas into business-relevant capabilities

•Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred qualifications:

•Experience in logistics, supply chain, shipping, transportation, or another optimisation-heavy industry

•Exposure to large-scale network design, routing, fleet planning, cargo flow optimisation, or similar decision systems

•Experience using AI or ML to improve optimisation performance, such as learning-augmented algorithms, surrogate models, search guidance, or reinforcement learning

•Experience working across research, prototyping, and productionisation of optimisation methods

Leadership expectations:

This role is expected to lead through others. The Principal AI Engineer should create the technical direction, decision framework, and quality standards for a broader team of optimisation, analytics, and AI specialists. The role should not be framed as a lone architect writing models end to end. It should be framed as the senior leader who sets the optimisation intelligence agenda and ensures that specialist work compounds into a coherent capability.

jobs.description:
Opportunity:

At Maersk, we are transforming global logistics through innovation, operational excellence, and customer-centric solutions. Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) is a critical enabler of that transformation, helping us build trust, strengthen customer partnerships, and support sustainable business growth.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Customer HSE & Strategic Partnerships to lead strategic HSE engagement with selected Global Key Customers across Logistics & Services (L&S). This role will position HSE as a strategic differentiator by translating Maersk's HSE capabilities, governance, compliance programs, and risk management expertise into tangible customer value.

Working at the intersection of HSE, commercial strategy, customer engagement, and governance, you will build trusted partnerships with senior customer stakeholders, support business growth opportunities, and establish the governance frameworks required to manage strategic customer HSE requirements across a global organization.

What We Offer

This is a unique opportunity to shape how Maersk engages with key customers on HSE, compliance, sustainability, and risk management topics.

You will work across a highly diverse global stakeholder landscape, collaborate closely with commercial, legal, operational, and leadership teams, and play a key role in strengthening long-term customer HSE partnerships while enabling business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Customer Engagement

• 
Lead strategic HSE partnerships with selected Global Key Customers.

• 
Support executive and senior-level customer engagements.

• 
Contribute to strategic commercial opportunities by articulating the value of Maersk's HSE and sustainability capabilities.

• 
Develop customer-facing HSE value propositions, thought leadership materials, and executive presentations.

Customer HSE Governance & Commercial Support

• 
Establish governance, escalation, and decision-making frameworks for managing strategic customer HSE requirements across Logistics & Services.

• 
Coordinate significant customer HSE commitments and ensure alignment across relevant functions.

• 
Develop and maintain customer-facing HSE materials, capability portfolios, and response frameworks.

• 
Drive consistency, quality, and accuracy in external HSE communications and customer engagements.

• 
Leverage data analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify emerging customer needs, trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Risk, Compliance & Contractual Support

• 
Continuously develop HSE compliance, and risk management requirements within customer contracts and supplier standards.

• 
Partner with Commercial and Legal teams to evaluate significant HSE commitments.

• 
Monitor evolving customer expectations, regulatory developments, and industry trends.

• 
Translate complex HSE, risk, and compliance requirements into practical business solutions and customer value propositions.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded leader who combines strong HSE expertise with exceptional stakeholder engagement and business partnering capabilities.

You thrive in complex global organizations, are comfortable engaging at executive level, and understand how governance, compliance, and risk management can create value for customers and the business.

Preferred Qualifications

• 
Relevant Master’s Degree with Occupational Health, Safety, Environment, Compliance or similar.

• 
Significant experience in HSE, Risk Management, Compliance, Sustainability, Operations, or a related discipline.

• 
Strong knowledge of management systems and international standards, including ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001.

• 
Solid experience with Power BI, business intelligence platforms, data mining and advanced reporting tools is an advantage.

• 
Experience utilizing digital, analytical, and AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, decision-making and customer engagement.

• 
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into business insights and recommendations.

• 
Demonstrated experience developing governance frameworks, policies, controls, and escalation processes in large, complex organizations.

• 
Strong commercial acumen and customer engagement experience.

• 
Experience working in global, matrixed environments.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and relationship-building skills.

• 
Strong executive communication, presentation, and storytelling capabilities.

• 
Ability to communicate complex technical requirements in a clear and commercially relevant manner.

Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

Responsibilities and technologies

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Ensuring the quality of the solution through various types of testing

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting

About you

You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

• Can navigate complex error scenarios and understand complex system landscapes

• Are systematic and detail-oriented throughout the analysis, design, development, and testing phases

• Think logically and analytically, and can break down and understand complex concepts and communicate issues and gaps clearly and effectively

• Thrive on a methodical and structured approach to your work

• Hold a relevant master’s degree

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

jobs.description:
Opportunity

At Maersk, we connect people, businesses and markets across the world through one of the most complex logistics networks ever built. As a Senior Operations Research Engineer, Ocean Network Optimization, you will join a team at the forefront of transforming how global trade moves. Leveraging advanced analytics, mathematical modelling and optimisation algorithms, we solve some of the industry's toughest challenges, from improving shipping container flows and vessel routing to designing resilient ocean networks that balance cost, service, sustainability and reliability. Your work will directly influence operational and strategic decisions that shape the future of global supply chains.

This is an opportunity to do more than build models. You will define and solve high-impact problems, lead innovative optimisation capabilities from concept through implementation, and help drive the shift towards data-driven, model-led decision making across Maersk's global ocean network. Working alongside talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds and disciplines, you will combine deep technical expertise with practical business impact, mentoring others and turning complex ideas into scalable solutions. If you are excited by tackling real-world problems at global scale and seeing your work create measurable value across one of the world's largest ocean logistics networks, Maersk offers an unparalleled platform to make your mark.

Within your impact and responsibilities, you will:

• Design advanced optimisation models and heuristics and take them from idea to validated and implemented capability

• Frame complex planning problems as clear mathematical formulations with explicit assumptions and success criteria

• Build reusable modelling components that follow modern engineering standards and integrate with production data systems

• Improve existing optimisation logic by closing gaps and lifting performance and scalability

• Run structured experiments to compare alternatives and verify model behaviour with data

• Translate findings into clear recommendations and partner with stakeholders to drive implementation and adoption

• Shape the innovation roadmap by identifying new application areas and accelerating promising concepts into pilots and scale

• Coach junior analysts and raise standards in modelling practice, documentation and code quality

• Communicate results, trade offs and limitations in simple and decision-oriented language

What you'll be accountable for:

• Integrity, stability and performance of optimisation logic used in planning and decision making

• Robust validation and successful implementation of new modelling features with clear readiness criteria

• Clear documentation of assumptions, constraints and data dependencies to support transparent decisions

• A value based and well prioritised modelling backlog focused on measurable business impact and time to value

• Demonstrated improvements in modelling logic, scalability and performance in real planning scenarios

• Effective adoption and correct use of optimisation capabilities across the user community with visible change outcomes

• Active contribution to the optimisation innovation pipeline by shaping new concepts, evaluating emerging methods and advancing promising ideas toward pilots and scale

• Leadership in the transformation agenda by helping teams shift from manual work to model driven planning and ensuring new solutions are embedded and used with confidence

You can offer:

• A PhD or master's degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field with exposure to optimisation or modelling

• Documented experience designing and deploying optimisation models or decision support algorithms in operational or production environments

• Expert level Python skills, experience applying C++ for performance critical components and strong SQL capabilities

• Advanced knowledge of Operations Research, including Mixed Integer Programming, graph theory, decomposition methods, and large-scale optimisation

• Strength in problem framing, algorithm design, empirical validation and scaling solutions

• Confident use of Git and modern software engineering workflows

• Ability to collaborate smoothly across diverse functions and to build strong working relationships that support clear communication, shared problem solving and aligned decision making

• Ability to lead change by guiding stakeholders through adoption, explaining trade offs and ensuring appropriate use of models

• A disciplined approach to documentation, testing, version control and reproducibility

It is a plus if you also bring:

• Familiarity with GPU based acceleration or parallel computation for optimising large problem instances

• Experience with AI or machine learning methods

• Knowledge of deep learning architectures and training workflows

• Background in advanced statistics or statistical inference

• Experience with time series modelling or forecasting techniques

If you're ready to jump in, push the boundaries of modelling and optimisation, and make a visible impact from day one, let’s connect. We’re excited to see the ideas, expertise, and momentum you’ll bring as we elevate Maersk’s decision‑support capabilities and shape the future of our network planning technologies.

jobs.occupation: Sales & Trade Marketing Manager ( m/w/d) - Germany
jobs.description:
About Stauning

Twenty years ago, nine friends in Stauning — a small village on Denmark's wild west coast — decided to make whisky. Not because Denmark had a whisky tradition, but because they believed Danish grain, Danish water, and Danish design could create something the world hadn't tasted before. They were right.

Today Stauning is Denmark's largest whisky distillery, co-owned by its founders and Diageo, and a Spirits Business Whisky Brand of the Year. We still floor-malt our own locally grown rye and barley and distil over direct fire in small copper pot stills. Germany is one of our most important markets — home to some of the most knowledgeable whisky drinkers in the world, a strong specialist retail scene, and many of our most loyal distillery visitors. We're now looking for someone to take it further.

The role

This is a sales & trade marketing role with a commercial backbone. You will own the day-to-day commercial marketing for the German market: building the annual customer plan for Germany, working alongside our distribution partner, selling into specialist retail and grocery, and ensuring that wherever Stauning shows up in Germany, it shows up well.

You will build channel playbooks with our central marketing team and turn them into sell-in stories, activations, tastings, and visibility that grow distribution and the rate of sale in Germany. Roughly half your time will be spent in the field with customers and our distributor; the rest on planning, activation, and reporting.

The Sales & Trade Marketing Manager will report direct to our Marketing Director, and work closely together with our Area Manager Central Europe

We expect arround 50% Field based and 50% Home Office, North Germany .

Key responsiblities

• 
Support and challenge our German distribution partner — joint business planning, sell-in of new releases and limited editions, target setting, and regular field visits together.

• 
Sell into and grow specialist whisky retail and premium on-trade accounts in major German cities, building lasting relationships with buyers, bartenders, and store owners.

• 
Deliver measurable growth in distribution and rate of sale for our core range and land limited editions with the retailers who love them.

• 
Adapt central brand plans and playbooks into a German commercial calendar — promotions, activations, and launches tailored to the German trade.

• 
Grocery plans and seeding –building seeding and success in targeted independents

• 
Plan and run tastings, masterclasses, and trade events, and represent Stauning at the German trade fairs and whisky festivals that matter.

• 
Ensure brand visibility and effective merchandising — point of sale, staff training, and in-store presence that reflect the way Stauning looks and sounds.

• 
Manage the German trade budget with clear ROI R, and analyse which investments and programmes actually move the needle.

• 
Be the voice of the German market internally — feeding customer insight, competitor activity, and opportunities back to the team in Denmark.

What success looks like

• 
An agreed annual commercial plan for Germany, reviewed regularly with our distributor and key accounts.

• 
Measurable growth in weighted distribution and rate of sale in specialist retail and on-trade.

• 
Strong, consistent trade execution — the brand visible, correct, and well-merchandised across the market.

• 
A trade budget spent deliberately, with clear reporting on what worked.

• 
Feel like part of the distributors team, understanding their business, pain points and working from their office twice per month to create a strong relationship

What are we looking for

• 
Based in Northern Germany – near Bremen / Hamburg.

• 
You have a relevant education.

• 
Experienced in spirits or premium drinks in the North German market — ideally with time on both the sales and trade marketing side.

• 
Well-networked in German specialist retail, grocery and/or premium on-trade, and comfortable opening doors that aren't yet open.

• 
A confident host: happy leading a tasting for thirty buyers or a quiet conversation with one.

• 
Commercially sharp — you read sell-out data, spot what's working, and adjust.

• 
Fluent in German and English.

• 
Willing to travel across North Germany regularly, and to the distillery in Stauning.

• 
Aligned with our values: Passion, Curiosity, Authenticity, Decency, and Financial Responsibility.

What we offer

The chance to build a market for a whisky the world is still discovering, with real ownership and short lines to decision-makers — including the founders. A warm, ambitious team split between Denmark and the markets we serve, competitive terms, and a standing invitation to the west coast of Jutland, where the whisky is made and the wind never quite stops.

Good working conditions.

How to apply

If you are interested in applying for this exciting position, please send your application and CV via the link, in the top right corner: "Apply" for the position.

We process applications on an ongoing basis, so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Marianne Holst Larsen (+45) 40837593 or mail: Marianne@holstlarsen.dk

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Analytic Number Theory, Automorphic Forms and Representation Theory
jobs.description:
The Department of Mathematics at Aarhus University invites applications for two two-year Assistant Professor positions in Analytic Number Theory, Automorphic Forms and Representation Theory, available from February 1, 2027. The successful candidates will be affiliated with the "Estimates for L-functions" project, led by Professor Paul D. Nelson and funded by the Villum Foundation. The project will concern research in some part of analytic number theory, automorphic forms and/or representation theory, building on recent advances in these subjects.

Qualifications
Applicants should hold a PhD degree in mathematics and have a strong research record in analytic number theory, automorphic forms, representation theory, or related areas. The ability to conduct independent research, as well as to collaborate effectively within the research group, will be emphasized. Experience in teaching at the university level and the ability to contribute to the department’s research-based teaching activities (including associated examination duties) in mathematics are expected. The position may also include knowledge exchange with society.

We offer
• A stimulating research environment with a strong international profile. Opportunities to collaborate with leading experts in analytic number theory and related fields.
• A well-supported research infrastructure, including access to travel funds and research visitors.
• A vibrant department with active seminar series and workshops.
 
About the department
The Department of Mathematics at Aarhus University is internationally recognized for excellence in research and teaching. It hosts several research groups in pure and applied mathematics and offers a dynamic and collegial academic atmosphere. More information about the department can be found at https://math.au.dk.

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Mathematics, Aarhus University, Ny Munkegade 118, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Contact information
For further information, please contact Professor Paul David Nelson, paul.nelson@math.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 26 October 2026. 

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment. 

Formalities and salary range 
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

At the Faculty of Natural Science at Aarhus University, we strive to support our scientific staff in their career development. We focus on competency development and career clarification and want to make your opportunities transparent. On our website, you can find information on all types of scientific positions, as well as the entry criteria we use when assessing candidates. You can also read more about how we can assist you in your career planning and development.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.
